text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Daitaku Helios, the party-girl Umamusume. 
Her Twinkle Series journey begins 
alongside the Trainer, fueled by her 
dead-serious love for racing.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her crush is Daiichi Ruby of the "Sublime 
Lineage." However, after getting super 
dumped because "their ways of seeing the 
world are entirely different," she's 
totally crying.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Ran into Mejiro Palmer while dealing with 
heartbreak. Hit karaoke for now, mood's 
totally hyped. Besties for life unlocked☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Daitaku Helios is super hyped up! Her days 
of training with Trai-P begin now!
